purpose: Teach: 地方裁判所/光学/良識/米価/併合/異質/筆記/伝授

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、地方裁判所での審理を、警察、立ち会われますね
lines.en: The police will be attending the district court hearing for this case, won't they?
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly formal inquiry. Soft rising inflection on the question tag. Lean forward with genuine curiosity. Measured pace, almost academic.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、光学機器の不正持ち出しを扱います
lines.en: We handle cases involving the illegal removal of optical equipment.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact delivery. Clear, official register without coldness. Steady eye contact. Slight emphasis on 'illegal' — professional clarification, not accusation.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、市民の良識に訴える防犯活動を、警察、進められますね
lines.en: The police drive community crime prevention programs that appeal to citizens' civic responsibility, correct?
lines.style: Thoughtful affirmation with gentle curiosity. Nod of understanding. Warm but formal tone. Slightly slower pace, leaving room for agreement.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、米価操作の不正もご捜査ですね
lines.en: And we also investigate cases of price manipulation in agricultural commodities.
lines.style: Steady, factual confirmation. Professional agreement without condescension. Brief pause after opening. Measured delivery of each phrase.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、組織の併合を悪用した詐欺を、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: The police also investigate fraud cases where merger procedures have been exploited, yes?
lines.style: Reflective, slightly impressed tone. Pause before the question tag. Respectful engagement with procedural complexity. Attentive listening quality in the voice.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、異質な事案にも柔軟に対応します
lines.en: We're equipped to respond flexibly to cases that fall outside standard categories.
lines.style: Confident, assured statement of capability. Slight emphasis on 'flexibly' — demonstrating adaptability. Professional pride without boasting. Clear, even delivery.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、容疑者の筆記習慣を、警察、分析されますね
lines.en: I understand the police also analyze suspects' writing patterns as part of investigations?
lines.style: Genuinely interested, almost deferential inquiry. Slightly tentative phrasing — respecting expertise. Lean toward conversational warmth while maintaining formality.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、捜査技術の伝授も若手におこなわれますね
lines.en: And the department passes on investigative techniques to younger officers, I'd imagine?
lines.style: Warm, slightly admiring observation. Conversational ease beneath the formal register. A small smile in the voice. Collaborative rather than interrogative.
